The called facade does only process_inbox_pr_review.delay (stamphog/backend/facade/api.py:147-155), so there is no durable pending intent before the publication. A failed publication or process exit after the source commit leaves neither a Celery delivery nor a ReviewRun. The three retries at stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:1109 apply only once execution begins. votes.refutation: I looked for an outbox hidden in the facade, callback failure propagation, producer recovery, and automatic source-save replay. The facade has no write, and the callback swallows the error, as tested by review_hog/backend/tests/test_inbox_trigger.py:358-369. Producer retries cannot recover a process that exits before publication or a failure after their finite attempts. Later output saves can refire, but ordinary completion/state saves are filtered by receivers.py:85-89 and no later eligible write is guaranteed. Thus keeping the caller save successful currently trades away its review request under a reachable broker/process failure; manual refire limits the impact.
